statusNotes.EXISTS_VERIFIED: Feature was already present on main and was audited rather than rebuilt.
statusNotes.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_TESTED: Pure logic/engine implemented in this branch and covered by green JVM unit tests. Not counted as VERIFIED because the Compose UI wiring and/or on-device E2E path has not been exercised (no emulator/SSH server is available on the build host).
statusNotes.NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT: Pre-existing partial support on main; not modified in this branch. Left as a follow-up.
statusNotes.BLOCKED: Cannot be implemented safely within the current stack; reason recorded per-feature. A BLOCKED entry may still carry a tested pure core (see its artifacts) when the risky transport half is what is actually blocked.
statusNotes.DEFERRED_WITH_REASON: Deliberately out of scope with an explicit reason.

features.title: Multi-hop Jump Host / ProxyJump
features.evidence: Pure ProxyJump planner: parses [user@]host[:port] comma lists with bracketed IPv6, the literal none, a depth cap of 8 and reason keys for bad hop/port/host; plan() allocates one local forward per hop. Hop grammar is reused from QuickConnect. JVM tests green.
features.remaining: The tunnel-chain transport (independent hop authentication + host-key verification) is not implemented; JschSshClient still refuses a jump host rather than silently going direct.
features.note: Feature status stays BLOCKED: JSch has no native ProxyJump and the tunnel chain is high risk. JumpChain opens no socket; it is planning only.
